decisions.reason: As a classic multi-model handle line in the firm's core business, it still supports standard project specifications and budget coverage despite some portfolio-overlap risk after four years.
This family reinforces the firm's breadth for architects and planners, and established handle families are typically retained unless they clearly underperform.

Because it is a single design in a crowded core category and no longer appears prominently observed, a large supplier would likely rationalize it to free resources for stronger families and newer priorities.
A multi-model lever-handle family fits the firm's strategy of offering broad, design-led specification options, so withdrawal within the next year remains relatively unlikely.
